title: 第295章 肚子疼（感谢伊甸星小宝打赏加更）
slug: 极寒末世我有空间囤货躺平
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

众人不理解田曼琪的意思，但还是照做。

田曼琪笑着解释：

“我这边的块大一些，队伍里不少人身体很弱，大家照顾着点，等到了庇护所就都能吃饱饭了。”

不少老人，和身体不好的人们，笑着感恩田曼琪的好，慢慢凑到田曼琪这一队来。

“还得是我们小田心地善良啊，知道顾着我们……”

“谢谢你啊，田总管。”

人们一边道着谢，一块一块领走沾着药粉的饼子。

自然也有强壮的人不高兴。

“大家都是一样的，凭什么他们吃大的？”

“谁都不轻松，只照顾身体差的算什么？”

田曼琪仍然笑呵呵的，慢慢解释：

“平日里咱们队伍行进慢，主要是一部分人身体不好走不快，咱们多照顾着点，他们体力上来了，咱们走的也能快些，对大家都有好处。”

伸手不打笑脸人。

田曼琪作为总管都这么说了，大伙也不好再说啥。

众人领了饼子，小口小口吃下。

随后又哀求着让田曼琪发水。

田曼琪一脸严厉的拒绝了，说这是最后的救命水，谁都不能动。

众人吃过饼子沉沉睡去。

睡到一半，正是正午最热的时候。

有人哀嚎起来。

“哎呦，肚子疼，疼死我了！！”

“好疼……救命……”

越来越多的人开始呻吟求救。

田曼琪紧闭着眼，抱着水桶面对着墙，一声不吭。

平日里保护田曼琪的强壮男人就睡在她旁边，眼看大多数人都不对劲，他伸手推了推田曼琪：

“田总管，你快起来看看，大家好像不对劲。”

田曼琪看自己没办法再继续装睡。

她神色痛苦地捂着胃坐起身。

她虚弱地问：“大家怎么了？”

“大家都说肚子疼，有不少人嘴唇都是紫的。”

强壮的男人四周看了两眼，这才回答。

田曼琪没说话，她紧紧捂着胃和肚子，深深地弓起了腰。

“田，田总管！你不会也肚子疼吧！”

强壮的男人紧张极了，怎么连田总管也……

Page (1/3)

Everyone didn't understand what Tian Manqi meant, but they still did it.

Tian Manqi explained with a smile:

"The area here is bigger. Many people in the team are very weak. Please take care of them so that they can have enough to eat when we get to the shelter."

Many old people and people in poor health smiled and thanked Tian Manqi for her kindness, and slowly joined Tian Manqi's team.

"It must be that our Xiaotian is kind-hearted and knows how to take care of us..."

"Thank you, Manager Tian."

People said their thanks and took away the cakes dipped in medicinal powder one by one.

Naturally there are strong people who are unhappy.

"Everyone is the same, why should they eat the big ones?"

"It's not easy for anyone. What's the point of just taking care of those in poor health?"

Tian Manqi still smiled and slowly explained:

"On weekdays, our team moves slowly, mainly because some people are not in good health and can't walk fast. Let's take more care of them. As their strength improves, we can walk faster, which is good for everyone."

Don’t reach out to hit the smiling person.

As the general manager, Tian Manqi said this, so it was hard for everyone to say anything else.

Everyone received the pancakes and ate them in small bites.

Then he begged Tian Manqi to get wet.

Tian Manqi refused sternly, saying that this was the last life-saving water and no one could touch it.

Everyone ate the cakes and fell asleep.

Halfway through sleeping, it was the hottest time at noon.

Someone wailed.

"Ouch, my stomach hurts. It hurts me so much!!"

"It hurts...help..."

More and more people began to moan for help.

Tian Manqi closed her eyes tightly, holding the bucket and facing the wall, saying nothing.

The strong man who usually protects Tian Manqi is sleeping next to her. Seeing that most people are not right, he reaches out and pushes Tian Manqi:

"Manager Tian, please get up and take a look, something seems to be wrong with everyone."

Tian Manqi saw that she could no longer pretend to sleep.

She looked in pain and sat up, holding her stomach.

She asked weakly: "What's wrong with everyone?"

"Everyone said they had stomachaches, and many people had purple lips."

The strong man looked around before answering.

Tian Manqi didn't say anything. She clutched her stomach tightly and arched her waist deeply.

"Tian, Manager Tian! Don't you have a stomachache too?"

The strong man was extremely nervous. How could even Manager Tian...
